module: BeamNG's telemetry core (GE extension telemetry_core, depends on telemetry_configManager). It decides whether telemetry is active (consent in the settings, launch arguments, server config), buffers the events sent by the trackers (addEvent), writes them as JSON Lines in /telemetry/sessions/<id>.jsonl, automatically loads the trackers from the telemetry/trackers/ folder enabled by the config and the jsonFileReporter reporter that sends the sessions of previous runs. A modder normally does not need to call it; they can only observe the onTelemetryEventAdded hook.
usage:
-- from a tracker: one-off event and duration
telemetry_core.addEvent({name = "monEvenement", valeur = 3})
telemetry_core.startActivity("menu", {page = "options"})
telemetry_core.endActivity("menu")
notes: Disabling: platform ps5/ps5pro; argument -notelemetry (takes priority over everything); AI agent mode (Engine.isAgentMode); verified tech license; otherwise the settings onlineFeatures == 'enable' and telemetry == 'enable' are required (the value 'ask' keeps telemetry off).

Argument -telemetryLocal: all trackers active, nothing sent, data in /telemetry/local/. Argument -telemetry, or any non-shipping build: telemetry forced (a code comment says the non-shipping case is temporary).
When telemetry is off, eventBuffer is nil and addEvent returns false without doing anything.
Events are written to disk every 100 events, on deactivation and on triggerReportWrite. Each event receives a field t = os.clockhp(); do not set event.t yourself (an error is logged).

The session identifier is 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SSZ_<sha256 of random bytes>' (85 characters). After a reload of the Lua VMs (luaVmStartReason == 'reload'), the session is resumed if the runIds have not changed.
The 'session' tracker is loaded first (priority 1), the others at priority 500; on unload the order is reversed. A tracker absent or disabled in moduleConfigs is not loaded.
If the runIds change after the session is opened, a new session is created; the old one is deleted if it was not collecting for any run ("stub" session from startup).

dependencies.desc: {'telemetry_configManager'}: declared but not called on demand, so that the trackers do not start before the config is initialized.

addEvent.desc: Adds an event to the session buffer. The event must be a table with a name field (non-empty string). Adds t = os.clockhp() to it, calls the hook onTelemetryEventAdded(event), encodes it as JSON on one line and flushes the buffer to disk every 100 events.

event.desc: Event: name required, other fields free, t forbidden.

returns.desc: true if the event was stored, false if it was refused (telemetry inactive, invalid table, missing name).

startActivity.desc: Adds the event {name = activityName, type = 'start'} merged with data, to measure a duration with endActivity.

endActivity.desc: Adds the event {name = activityName, type = 'end'} merged with data.

triggerReportWrite.desc: Immediately writes the buffered events to the session file, so they survive a crash.

getDataFolder.desc: Telemetry data folder: '/telemetry/local/' in -telemetryLocal mode (separate sessions and surveys, never sent by a normal run's reporter), otherwise '/telemetry/'.

getSessionFile.desc: .jsonl file of the current session. The reporter must neither send nor delete it.

returns.desc: Path, or nil if there is no session.

getSessionId.desc: Session identifier: timestamp plus random bytes, unrelated to the account token or an identity. Used to recognize a duplicate resend after a lost response.

getRunTime.desc: Elapsed time in seconds (os.clockhp()), used by the trackers to measure durations.

getRunIds.desc: List of telemetry runs (runIds from the server config) for which the session collects. Set before the trackers are loaded.

isSessionContinued.desc: Indicates whether the current session resumes the one from before a Lua reload.

returns.desc: true if the session is resumed.

isPlatformSupported.desc: Returns false for the 'ps5' and 'ps5pro' platforms, true otherwise.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook: sets the unload mode to manual, enables telemetry if shouldTelemetryBeActive(); otherwise closes the previous session and stays in no-effect mode.

previousSession.desc: Data returned by onSerialize before a Lua reload (sessionId, runIds).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Unload hook: disables telemetry (writes the remaining events, unloads trackers and reporter) and turns off the config polling.

onExit.desc: Hook called when the game closes; same function as onExtensionUnloaded.

onSerialize.desc: Serialization hook: on a Lua reload (reason == 'reload') with a valid session, returns {sessionId, runIds} to resume the session afterwards.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook called when the settings change: enables or disables telemetry according to consent, and turns off config polling if it is inactive.
